description: Auto Captions — Upload a video with spoken audio and generate an MP4 result. Watch the captioned video before you share it.. AI Studio run — dispatches to our AI workers (Modal). All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
